Job Description

We are looking for a hands-on, consultative AI Lead to sit at the front line of client engagements and turn AI ambition into working software. You will run discovery with clients, shape priority use cases into buildable solutions, and then personally build the prototypes, agents, and phase-0 MVPs that create client conviction and accelerate deal conversion.

This is a forward deployed role: you work shoulder-to-shoulder with clients and the account team rather than behind a delivery firewall. Success is measured by how quickly a vague business problem becomes a demonstrable AI capability with a credible value hypothesis.

It sits at the intersection of AI engineering, solution design, and business value — and is best suited to a strong builder who is comfortable in ambiguous, fast-moving sales cycles and enjoys being the technical voice in the room.

Roles & Responsibilities

Discovery and use-case shaping
Run early-stage discovery sessions and working groups with clients and account teams.
Identify pain points, value levers, and high-impact AI opportunities across the client's process landscape.
Translate vague or complex client questions into clear solution hypotheses, initial architectural logic, and a prioritised use-case backlog.
Build AI scenarios and "before/after" narratives that illustrate meaningful business transformation, with measurable outcomes attached.
Build and prove
Design AI solutions end to end for a given use case — LLM choice, prompt and context design, data sources, retrieval, tools, integrations, and a usable front end — working with the AI Architect on platform-level decisions.
Build prototypes, storyboards, demos, accelerators, and reusable agentic blueprints at pursuit speed.
Engineer and validate AI agents for reliability, reasoning quality, safety, and performance; stand up evaluation harnesses so claims are evidence-backed rather than anecdotal.
Lead PoCs, pilots, and phase-0 MVPs across industries, owning scope, timeline, and the technical outcome.
Client-facing content and conviction
Create client-ready material: solution and architecture decks, demo storylines, value frameworks, effort estimates, and inputs into proposals and SoWs.
Lead technical walkthroughs, deep-dives, and competitive differentiation discussions with client engineering and business stakeholders.
Refine solution narratives based on client feedback, objections, and market conditions.
Continuity and uplift
Own a clean handover from pursuit to delivery — architecture intent, code, decisions, risks, and open questions documented and transferred.
Contribute reusable assets back to the practice: accelerators, agent patterns, eval suites, reference implementations.
Mentor 2–5 engineers on agentic engineering practice and raise the bar on prototype quality.
 Must-have skills and experience

Agentic AI engineering

Hands-on working knowledge of defining and configuring prompts, instructions, tools, reasoning strategies, guardrails, memory, and orchestration in AI agent development.
Practical experience with multi-step and multi-agent workflows, tool/function calling, and failure handling (retries, fallbacks, human-in-the-loop).

RAG and context engineering

Strong experience with RAG pipelines: chunking and indexing strategy, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid and re-ranked retrieval, evaluation of retrieval quality.
Working understanding of tokenization, context-window management, and cost/latency trade-offs.

Engineering craft

Hands-on experience creating and maintaining Python libraries; working command of LangChain (or equivalent orchestration frameworks), Hugging Face, OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and locally hosted open models.
Very strong experience developing RESTful APIs in Python with FastAPI (or similar) and integrating third-party services, UI components, and APIs.
Hands-on Docker-based deployment and disciplined use of Git/GitHub for source control, branching, and review — mandatory.
Enough front-end capability (React/Streamlit/Gradio or equivalent) to make a demo feel like a product.

Model provider and hyperscaler GenAI platform know-how

Working familiarity across the major frontier-model providers and hyperscaler AI platforms, with genuine in-depth, hands-on depth in at least one of the following:
Anthropic — Claude model family, Claude API, tool use, extended thinking, Claude Agent SDK, MCP (Model Context Protocol) for tool and data connectivity, Claude on Amazon Bedrock / Vertex AI.
OpenAI — GPT model family, Responses/Assistants APIs, Agents SDK, function calling, structured outputs, fine-tuning and batch APIs.
AWS — Amazon Bedrock (multi-model access, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Agents/AgentCore), SageMaker, and the surrounding data and security services.
Google — Gemini model family, Vertex AI (Model Garden, grounding, agent tooling), and Gemini enterprise offerings.
Microsoft Azure — Azure OpenAI / Azure AI Foundry, AI Agent Service, AI Search for retrieval, and Azure-native integration patterns.
Able to explain why a given provider or platform fits a client's constraints — model capability, context window, latency, cost per interaction, data residency and privacy posture, enterprise controls, existing cloud commitments — rather than defaulting to a personal favourite.
Comfortable building the same use case on more than one stack, and keeping solutions reasonably provider-portable so a client is not architecturally locked in by a prototype.

Consultative ability

Demonstrated ability to turn ambiguous business problems into crisp AI use cases with clear value hypotheses and measurable outcomes.
Strong communication and articulation skills; able to hold a technical room and a business room in the same meeting.
Hands-on prototyping mindset — able to quickly build functional demos, agent workflows, and LLM-powered interactions that accelerate client conviction.

 

Good to have
Prior pre-sales, consulting, or forward-deployed engineering exposure.
Depth in one or two industry domains (e.g. BFSI, healthcare/life sciences, retail, manufacturing, telecom).
Certification on a hyperscaler AI/ML track (AWS, Azure or Google), or equivalent demonstrable platform depth.
Familiarity with modern data platforms and their GenAI surfaces (Databricks, Snowflake Cortex, lakehouse patterns).
Experience with self-hosted / open-weight model deployment (vLLM, Ollama, Bedrock or Vertex custom endpoints) for clients with strict data-boundary requirements.
Exposure to LLM observability and evaluation tooling, and to responsible-AI and data-privacy considerations in regulated environments.

jobs.job_description:
Job Summary

The Elastic IT team is moving beyond simple chat to the next frontier: Agentic Workflows and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Systems. We are looking for an innovative Agentic AI Engineer to join our team. You will build multi-agent ecosystems that are self-directed. These ecosystems will do more than just answer questions. They will collaborate, delegate tasks, and execute complex business processes across the organization.

In this role, you will focus on large language models (LLMs), agent orchestration, and A2A integration frameworks to power our intelligent workforce. You will create workflows for multiple agents instead of just focusing on single-agent search or managing the stack. These workflows will enable the agents to communicate with each other, share information, access enterprise tools, and automate tasks from start to finish. Driven by a service-oriented mindset, you will empower internal teams with cutting-edge LLM capabilities while integrating seamlessly with enterprise systems.

Are you ready to build the next generation of LLM-powered multi-agent systems that supercharge enterprise productivity? Join us to enable agent-to-agent workflows that turn collective knowledge into instant, coordinated action across Elastic.

What You Will Be Doing
A2A Architecture & Multi-Agent Orchestration: Design, build, and deploy agent-to-agent (A2A) communication architectures and workflows that enable autonomous agents to collaborate, delegate tasks, and negotiate multi-step business processes.
LLM Integration & Tool Calling: Integrate advanced LLMs, both proprietary and open-source, with enterprise APIs. Use tool-calling methods. Connect with third-party SaaS applications for smooth operations.
Enterprise Grounding & RAG: Use advanced Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) techniques. Implement strategies that connect enterprise context by using search and vector storage engines. This will ensure that all inter-agent operations are highly accurate and reliable.
Scalable Infrastructure & IaC: Provision and manage robust cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) using Terraform to support the high-concurrency demands of LLM inferences and multi-agent coordination.
DevOps & Lifecycle Management: Support modern DevOps practices. This includes creating CI/CD pipelines for automated testing, deployment, and versioning. You will also evaluate LLMs and agentic workflows regularly.
A2A Security & Governance: Apply strict security and network fundamentals (VPC configurations, secure API gateways, encryption, and IAM controls) to secure inter-agent communication and protect sensitive enterprise data.
LLM Observability & Evaluation: Create systems to monitor how multiple agents interact. These systems will help us check model accuracy. They will also help manage token spending and identify model drift or agent loops.
Documentation: Keep detailed technical documents for LLM integration protocols. This includes A2A interaction flows and cloud infrastructure deployments.
What You Bring
LLM & GenAI Expertise: Deep experience integrating, fine-tuning, and optimizing foundation models (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models), including expertise in prompt engineering, tool calling, and structured outputs.
Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocols: Proven success building multi-agent systems, inter-agent messaging pipelines, state management frameworks, and dynamic task delegation protocols.
Agentic Frameworks: Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, AutoGen, etc. along with tracing platforms like LangSmith.
Market Trends & Interoperability: Strong understanding of emerging AI interoperability standards, such as the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and open multi-agent communication specifications.
Programming: Advanced proficiency in Python

Visit gomotive.com to learn more.
About the Team
Motives AI team builds the models and systems that let us see and understand whats happening on the road and in the field, across cameras, sensors, and millions of hours of fleet data. Our work spans model development, on-device deployment, and the cloud infrastructure that turns raw signals into products drivers and safety teams rely on every day.
About the Role
Were looking for an AI Engineer to work across the full stack: training and evaluating models, then getting them running in the real world and building the systems around them. Youll partner closely with platform, product, and firmware teams to ship your work.
Youll own the work end to end. You might spend one day improving a model, another building the pipeline that feeds it, and another in production tracking down why somethings off.
In this role, you will:
Research and develop machine learning models for perception and understanding problems across visual, audio, and other real-world signals.
Explore how specialized models and larger general-purpose models can work together in production systems.
Design data, training, and evaluation approaches that hold up under real-world conditions, not just in a notebook.
Study model behavior, robustness, and failure modes across data, deployment, and operating conditions.
Integrate and validate new capabilities in real-time or resource-constrained systems.
Work with firmware, platform, and product teams to turn research into working systems.
